Recording: %1$d seconds left. You can close this window and switch widgets.

The chart shows Android Auto decoder output over the last minute. Gaps mean no samples, not zero FPS. Settings can pause projection. CarPlay and AutoKit FPS are not measured here. A new AA session resets the chart and check.
